chief_complaint: Management of type 2 diabetes with hypertension and early chronic kidney disease
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 58-year-old woman with longstanding essential hypertension (since 2003) and type 2 diabetes mellitus requiring insulin therapy. Diabetic kidney disease was first documented in 2015 (CKD stage 1) and progressed to CKD stage 2 with micro‑albuminuria in November 2019. Obesity (BMI ≥30) has been present since 1991. She reports ongoing stress since 2018. A prior malignant neoplasm of the breast (diagnosed 1990) remains listed as active. The most recent outpatient encounter was on 2021-10-17; recent labs such as eGFR, lipid panel, and BMI are missing. Blood pressure is controlled (117/80 mmHg) and the latest A1c is 6.9 %.

clinical_impression: The patient has type 2 diabetes with adequate glycemic control, hypertension that is well managed, and early CKD stage 2 with micro‑albuminuria.
